These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. LBM Taylor–Green vortex: coupled grid/time/Mach sensitivity Evolve a nonlinear periodic2D vortex and save velocity/pressure/energy errors against the continuous analytic field. Distinguish amplitude probes from a fixed-grid coupled-step probe.
